lat_pulldown.apparatus: a cable lat pulldown station: tall frame with a pulley at the top, a long straight pulldown bar, a weight stack behind, a seat with a padded thigh roller locking the thighs
lat_pulldown.view: side view, mannequin seen from the side (never from behind), facing left toward the bar
lat_pulldown.start: seated upright, thighs held under the thigh pad, shins vertical, arms fully extended overhead holding the bar slightly wider than shoulder width, torso leaning back about 10 degrees, shoulder blades lifted
lat_pulldown.end: bar pulled down to the upper chest, elbows driven down and slightly back beside the ribs, chest up, torso still leaning back about 10 degrees, shoulder blades pulled down
lat_pulldown.path: the bar travels in a smooth vertical arc from overhead down to the upper chest

close_grip_lat_pulldown.apparatus: a cable lat pulldown station with a pulley at the top, a weight stack behind, a seat with a thigh roller, and a close-grip V handle on the cable
close_grip_lat_pulldown.view: side view, mannequin facing left toward the handle
close_grip_lat_pulldown.start: seated upright, thighs under the thigh pad, arms fully extended overhead holding the V handle with palms facing each other, torso leaning back about 10 degrees
close_grip_lat_pulldown.end: handle pulled down to the upper chest, elbows pointing down and back close to the ribs, chest up
close_grip_lat_pulldown.path: the handle travels down in a vertical line from overhead to the upper chest

pull_up.apparatus: a pull-up bar mounted high on a rack, no other equipment
pull_up.start: dead hang from the bar, arms fully straight, shoulder blades gently pulled down, legs slightly bent behind, body straight
pull_up.end: chin just above the bar, elbows pointing down toward the ribs, chest toward the bar, legs still slightly bent behind
pull_up.path: the body travels straight up and down along a vertical line, shown by the arrow beside the torso

squat.apparatus: a barbell squat rack with the bar resting on the upper back (high-bar position), plates on both ends of the bar, a flat floor
squat.view: side view, mannequin facing left, the whole body and the bar visible
squat.start: standing tall, feet shoulder-width apart with toes slightly turned out, bar across the upper back, hands gripping the bar, chest up, spine neutral, knees and hips fully extended
squat.end: bottom of the squat: thighs parallel to the floor or just below, knees tracking over the toes, torso leaning forward about 45 degrees with a neutral spine, heels flat on the floor, bar still directly over mid-foot
squat.path: the bar travels straight up and down in a vertical line over the middle of the foot

hack_squat.apparatus: a plate-loaded hack squat machine: a back pad angled about 45 degrees, a foot platform, shoulder pads, plates on a sled
hack_squat.start: standing on the platform with the back flat against the pad, shoulders under the shoulder pads, feet shoulder-width, knees and hips extended
hack_squat.end: deep squat down the slide, thighs below parallel, knees tracking over the toes, back and hips staying flat against the pad
hack_squat.path: the body and sled travel down and up along the angled slide of the machine

leg_press.apparatus: a 45-degree plate-loaded leg press machine: an inclined sled with plates, a reclined back pad, a foot platform, handles at the seat
leg_press.start: reclined on the back pad, feet shoulder-width on the middle of the platform, legs extended but knees not locked, hips and lower back flat against the pad
leg_press.end: knees bent to about 90 degrees toward the chest, hips and lower back still flat on the pad, feet flat on the platform
leg_press.path: the sled travels along the inclined rails, shown by the arrow along the rail

bulgarian_split_squat.apparatus: a flat bench behind the mannequin with the rear foot resting on it, a dumbbell held in each hand at the sides
bulgarian_split_squat.view: side view, mannequin facing left, the front leg nearest the viewer
bulgarian_split_squat.start: standing on the front leg, rear foot resting on the bench behind, front foot about two steps ahead of the bench, torso upright, a dumbbell hanging in each hand, front knee nearly straight
bulgarian_split_squat.end: front thigh about parallel to the floor, front knee tracking over the toes, torso slightly leaning forward with a neutral spine, rear knee bent and pointing toward the floor
bulgarian_split_squat.path: the hips travel straight down and up in a vertical line

leg_extension.apparatus: a seated leg extension machine: a back pad, a seat, a padded roller on the front of the ankles, a weight stack
leg_extension.start: seated with the back flat against the pad, knees bent about 90 degrees at the edge of the seat, ankles behind the roller
leg_extension.end: legs fully extended, knees straight but not hyperextended, the quadriceps visibly contracted, back still against the pad
leg_extension.path: the shin and roller travel in an arc from bent knee to straight leg

lying_leg_curl.apparatus: a lying leg curl machine: a flat padded bench lying face down, an ankle roller above the heels, a weight stack
lying_leg_curl.view: side view, mannequin facing left, lying face down
lying_leg_curl.start: lying face down, hips pressed to the bench, legs almost straight, the ankle roller just above the heels
lying_leg_curl.end: heels curled toward the glutes with the knees bent about 90 degrees or more, hips still pressed to the bench
lying_leg_curl.path: the ankles travel in an arc from the straight leg up toward the glutes

seated_leg_curl.apparatus: a seated leg curl machine: a back pad, a thigh pad pressing down on the thighs, an ankle pad under the calves, a weight stack
seated_leg_curl.start: seated with the back against the pad, thighs held down by the thigh pad, legs extended straight in front with the ankle pad over the lower calves
seated_leg_curl.end: knees bent to about 90 degrees or more, heels pulled down and back under the seat, thighs still held down
seated_leg_curl.path: the ankles travel in an arc from the straight leg down and back toward the seat

romanian_deadlift.apparatus: a barbell with plates held in front of the thighs, flat floor
romanian_deadlift.view: side view, mannequin facing left, the whole body from head to feet visible
romanian_deadlift.start: standing tall, feet hip-width apart, barbell held with an overhand grip hanging against the front of the thighs, knees soft (slightly bent), chest up, spine neutral
romanian_deadlift.end: hips pushed far back, torso tipped forward until it is nearly parallel to the floor with a flat neutral spine, knees only slightly bent and unchanged, the barbell hanging close to the shins just below the knees
romanian_deadlift.path: the bar slides straight down and up in a vertical line close to the thighs and shins

hip_thrust.apparatus: a flat bench with the mannequin's upper back resting on its edge, a barbell with plates across the hips (padded), flat floor
hip_thrust.view: side view, mannequin facing right, the shoulder blades on the bench edge
hip_thrust.start: upper back on the bench, hips lowered close to the floor, knees bent about 90 degrees, feet flat on the floor shoulder-width, barbell resting across the hips, chin tucked
hip_thrust.end: hips fully raised so that the torso and thighs form a straight line, shins vertical, knees bent about 90 degrees, glutes squeezed, ribs down
hip_thrust.path: the bar travels straight up and down in a vertical line over the hips

seated_calf_raise.apparatus: a plate-loaded seated calf raise machine: a seat, knee pads pressing on the thighs, a foot block under the balls of the feet
seated_calf_raise.start: seated upright, knees under the pad, balls of the feet on the block, heels lowered below the block for a full stretch of the calves
seated_calf_raise.end: heels lifted as high as possible, standing on the balls of the feet, calves fully contracted, knees still under the pad
seated_calf_raise.path: the heels travel straight up and down in a vertical line

standing_calf_raise.apparatus: a standing calf raise machine: shoulder pads, a foot block under the balls of the feet, a weight stack
standing_calf_raise.start: standing upright with the shoulders under the pads, balls of the feet on the block, heels lowered well below the block for a full calf stretch, legs straight
standing_calf_raise.end: heels lifted as high as possible, on the balls of the feet, calves fully contracted, legs straight, torso upright
standing_calf_raise.path: the heels travel straight up and down in a vertical line

bench_press.apparatus: a flat bench with a barbell on it, plates on both ends of the bar, a rack, feet flat on the floor
bench_press.view: side view, mannequin facing left, lying on the bench, feet flat on the floor
bench_press.start: lying on the bench with the shoulder blades pinched together, slight arch in the lower back, feet flat on the floor, the barbell held above the mid-chest with straight arms, grip slightly wider than shoulders
bench_press.end: the barbell lowered to touch the mid-chest, forearms vertical, elbows about 45 degrees from the torso (not flared out)
bench_press.path: the bar travels in a slight arc between the mid-chest and straight above the shoulders

dumbbell_bench_press.apparatus: a flat bench, a dumbbell in each hand, feet flat on the floor
dumbbell_bench_press.view: side view, mannequin facing left, lying on the bench
dumbbell_bench_press.start: lying on the bench with the shoulder blades pinched together, feet flat on the floor, dumbbells held above the chest with straight arms, palms facing the feet
dumbbell_bench_press.end: dumbbells lowered to the sides of the chest, upper arms about 45 degrees from the torso, forearms vertical, a deep chest stretch
dumbbell_bench_press.path: the dumbbells travel in a slight arc from beside the chest up to above the shoulders

incline_dumbbell_press.apparatus: an adjustable bench set to about 30 degrees incline, a dumbbell in each hand, feet flat on the floor
incline_dumbbell_press.view: side view, mannequin facing left, lying back on the inclined bench
incline_dumbbell_press.start: back against the incline bench, shoulder blades pinched together, feet flat on the floor, dumbbells held above the upper chest with straight arms, palms facing forward
incline_dumbbell_press.end: dumbbells lowered to the sides of the upper chest, upper arms about 45 degrees from the torso, forearms vertical, a deep chest stretch
incline_dumbbell_press.path: the dumbbells travel in a slight arc from beside the upper chest up to above the shoulders

machine_chest_press.apparatus: a seated chest press machine: an adjustable seat, a back pad, two handles at chest height, a weight stack
machine_chest_press.start: seated with the back flat against the pad, shoulder blades pinched back, hands holding the handles at mid-chest height with elbows bent, handles near the chest
machine_chest_press.end: arms pressed forward until almost straight, elbows soft, handles at mid-chest height, shoulders kept down and back
machine_chest_press.path: the handles travel in a straight horizontal line forward from the chest

cable_fly.apparatus: two cable stations with pulleys at about chest height and a D-handle on each cable, the mannequin standing between them in a staggered stance
cable_fly.view: front view of the mannequin standing between two cable towers, seen from the front (still faceless)
cable_fly.start: standing in a staggered stance, arms open wide at shoulder height with a slight bend in the elbows, hands holding the handles, chest stretched
cable_fly.end: hands brought together in front of the chest in a hugging arc, elbows keeping the same slight bend, chest squeezed
cable_fly.path: each hand travels in a wide arc from the open position to meeting in front of the chest

pec_deck.apparatus: a pec deck (butterfly) machine: a seat, a back pad, two vertical arms with handles or pads, a weight stack
pec_deck.view: front view of the mannequin seated in the machine, seen from the front (still faceless)
pec_deck.start: seated with the back flat against the pad, upper arms and forearms on the pads with elbows at shoulder height and opened wide, chest stretched
pec_deck.end: the arms brought together in front of the chest, elbows at shoulder height, chest squeezed, back still flat against the pad
pec_deck.path: each arm travels in an arc from wide open to meeting in front of the chest

push_up.view: side view, mannequin facing left, the whole body from head to feet visible
push_up.start: high plank: hands on the floor under the shoulders, arms straight, body in one straight line from head to heels, feet together
push_up.end: chest lowered close to the floor, elbows about 45 degrees from the torso, body still in one straight line, hips not sagging
push_up.path: the whole body travels straight down and up as one stiff plank

dip.apparatus: two parallel dip bars at hip height, nothing else
dip.start: supported on straight arms above the dip bars, shoulders pushed down, torso leaning slightly forward, legs crossed behind or hanging
dip.end: body lowered until the upper arms are about parallel to the floor, elbows bent about 90 degrees pointing back, chest slightly forward, legs behind
dip.path: the body travels straight down and up between the bars

overhead_press.apparatus: a barbell with plates, a standing position, a flat floor
overhead_press.start: standing with feet hip-width apart, barbell resting on the front of the shoulders held at shoulder width, elbows slightly in front of the bar, ribs down, glutes tight
overhead_press.end: barbell locked out directly above the middle of the feet with straight arms, head pushed slightly forward through the arms, ribs down, torso upright
overhead_press.path: the bar travels in a near-vertical line, moving slightly around the face and finishing over the mid-foot

dumbbell_shoulder_press.apparatus: a bench with the backrest set upright at about 80 degrees, a dumbbell in each hand
dumbbell_shoulder_press.view: side view, mannequin facing left, seated with the back against the upright bench
dumbbell_shoulder_press.start: seated with the back against the backrest, feet flat on the floor, dumbbells held at shoulder height with elbows bent about 90 degrees, palms facing forward
dumbbell_shoulder_press.end: dumbbells pressed overhead until the arms are straight, dumbbells nearly touching above the head, ribs down, back against the backrest
dumbbell_shoulder_press.path: the dumbbells travel in a slight inward arc from the shoulders to above the head

lateral_raise.apparatus: a dumbbell in each hand, standing, flat floor
lateral_raise.view: front view of the mannequin standing, seen from the front (still faceless)
lateral_raise.start: standing tall with a dumbbell hanging at each side, slight bend in the elbows, torso upright, shoulders relaxed
lateral_raise.end: arms lifted out to the sides until the upper arms are about shoulder height, a slight bend in the elbows kept, wrists not higher than the elbows
lateral_raise.path: each arm travels in a wide arc from the hip out to shoulder height

cable_lateral_raise.apparatus: a cable station with the pulley set low and a single D-handle, the mannequin standing sideways beside the tower holding the handle with the far hand
cable_lateral_raise.view: front view of the mannequin standing, seen from the front (still faceless), the cable tower beside the working arm
cable_lateral_raise.start: standing tall, the working arm across the front of the body holding the handle at the hip, slight bend in the elbow, torso upright
cable_lateral_raise.end: the working arm lifted out to the side until the upper arm is about shoulder height, slight bend in the elbow kept
cable_lateral_raise.path: the hand travels in an arc from across the hip out to shoulder height

rear_delt_fly.apparatus: a bench set to about 45 degrees with the mannequin leaning chest-down on it, a light dumbbell in each hand, feet on the floor
rear_delt_fly.view: side view, mannequin facing left, chest supported on the incline bench
rear_delt_fly.start: chest on the inclined bench, arms hanging straight down toward the floor holding the dumbbells, a slight bend in the elbows, neck neutral
rear_delt_fly.end: arms raised out to the sides until the upper arms are about parallel to the floor, slight elbow bend kept, shoulder blades gently squeezed
rear_delt_fly.path: each arm travels in a wide arc from hanging down to out to the sides

reverse_pec_deck.apparatus: a pec deck machine used in reverse: the mannequin seated facing the pad, chest against the chest pad, handles in front at shoulder height, a weight stack
reverse_pec_deck.view: side view, mannequin facing left, chest on the pad
reverse_pec_deck.start: seated with the chest against the pad, arms extended forward holding the handles at shoulder height, slight bend in the elbows
reverse_pec_deck.end: arms swept out and back until the upper arms are in line with the shoulders, shoulder blades squeezed, chest still against the pad
reverse_pec_deck.path: each arm travels in a wide arc from in front to out to the sides

face_pull.apparatus: a cable station with the pulley set at about face height and a rope attachment, a weight stack
face_pull.view: side view, mannequin facing left toward the rope
face_pull.start: standing with feet staggered, arms extended forward holding the two ends of the rope at face height, slight lean back, shoulders down
face_pull.end: rope pulled toward the face, the hands splitting apart on either side of the head, elbows high and wide at shoulder height, shoulder blades squeezed
face_pull.path: the rope travels in a straight horizontal line from the pulley to the face

barbell_row.apparatus: a barbell with plates on the floor, the mannequin standing over it, flat floor
barbell_row.view: side view, mannequin facing left, the whole body from head to feet visible
barbell_row.start: hinged forward at the hips with the torso about 45 degrees to the floor, flat neutral spine, knees slightly bent, arms hanging straight down holding the barbell at the knees with an overhand grip
barbell_row.end: the barbell pulled to the lower ribs, elbows pointing back past the torso, shoulder blades squeezed, torso angle unchanged
barbell_row.path: the bar travels in a straight line from the knees up to the lower ribs, close to the body

one_arm_dumbbell_row.apparatus: a flat bench with the mannequin's same-side hand and knee resting on it, a dumbbell in the free hand, flat floor
one_arm_dumbbell_row.view: side view, mannequin facing left, one hand and one knee on the bench
one_arm_dumbbell_row.start: one hand and the same-side knee on the bench, the other foot on the floor, back flat and nearly parallel to the floor, the free arm hanging straight down holding the dumbbell
one_arm_dumbbell_row.end: the dumbbell pulled to the hip, elbow pointing up and back past the torso, back still flat, shoulder blade squeezed
one_arm_dumbbell_row.path: the dumbbell travels in a straight line from below the shoulder to the hip

chest_supported_row.apparatus: a chest-supported row machine: an inclined chest pad, a seat, two handles in front at arm's length, a weight stack
chest_supported_row.view: side view, mannequin facing left, chest on the pad
chest_supported_row.start: chest against the pad, arms extended forward gripping the handles, shoulder blades spread slightly apart, back flat
chest_supported_row.end: handles pulled back until the elbows are behind the torso, shoulder blades squeezed together, chest still on the pad
chest_supported_row.path: the handles travel in a straight horizontal line from in front toward the torso

seated_row.apparatus: a seated cable row station: a low pulley, a V handle on the cable, a foot plate, a seat, a weight stack
seated_row.view: side view, mannequin facing left toward the cable
seated_row.start: seated upright with the feet on the plate and the knees slightly bent, torso leaning slightly forward, arms extended forward holding the handle, shoulder blades slightly protracted
seated_row.end: torso upright (not leaning back), the handle pulled to the lower stomach, elbows pointing back past the torso, shoulder blades squeezed
seated_row.path: the handle travels in a straight horizontal line from in front to the lower stomach

t_bar_row.apparatus: a plate-loaded T-bar row setup: a landmine bar anchored at one end with plates on the free end, a V handle across the bar, the mannequin straddling the bar
t_bar_row.start: straddling the bar, hinged forward at the hips with the torso about 45 degrees, flat neutral spine, knees slightly bent, arms extended down holding the handle
t_bar_row.end: handle pulled up to the chest, elbows pointing back past the torso, shoulder blades squeezed, torso angle unchanged
t_bar_row.path: the handle travels in an arc from below the chest up to the chest, following the lever of the bar

barbell_curl.apparatus: a straight barbell with plates, standing, flat floor
barbell_curl.start: standing tall, barbell held with an underhand shoulder-width grip hanging against the thighs, elbows tucked at the sides, arms straight
barbell_curl.end: barbell curled up to shoulder height, elbows still pinned at the sides, biceps fully contracted, torso not swinging
barbell_curl.path: the bar travels in an arc from the thighs to the front of the shoulders, elbows fixed

dumbbell_curl.apparatus: a dumbbell in each hand, standing, flat floor
dumbbell_curl.start: standing tall, dumbbells hanging at the sides with palms facing forward, elbows tucked at the sides, arms straight
dumbbell_curl.end: dumbbells curled up to shoulder height, elbows still pinned at the sides, biceps fully contracted, torso not swinging
dumbbell_curl.path: each dumbbell travels in an arc from the thigh to the front of the shoulder, elbow fixed

hammer_curl.apparatus: a dumbbell in each hand, standing, flat floor
hammer_curl.start: standing tall, dumbbells hanging at the sides with palms facing the thighs (neutral grip), elbows tucked at the sides, arms straight
hammer_curl.end: dumbbells curled up to shoulder height with the palms still facing each other, elbows pinned at the sides, torso not swinging
hammer_curl.path: each dumbbell travels in an arc from the thigh to the front of the shoulder, elbow fixed

reverse_curl.apparatus: a straight or EZ barbell with plates, standing, flat floor
reverse_curl.start: standing tall, barbell held with an overhand grip (palms facing down) shoulder-width, hanging against the thighs, elbows tucked at the sides
reverse_curl.end: barbell curled up to shoulder height with the overhand grip, wrists straight, elbows pinned at the sides, torso not swinging
reverse_curl.path: the bar travels in an arc from the thighs to the front of the shoulders, elbows fixed

triceps_pushdown.apparatus: a cable station with the pulley set high and a short bar or rope attachment, standing in front of it
triceps_pushdown.view: side view, mannequin facing left toward the cable
triceps_pushdown.start: standing tall with a slight forward lean, upper arms pinned at the sides, elbows bent about 90 degrees, hands holding the attachment at chest height
triceps_pushdown.end: arms pushed down until fully straight, attachment at the thighs, upper arms still pinned at the sides, triceps contracted
triceps_pushdown.path: the hands travel in a vertical arc from chest height down to the thighs, elbows fixed

overhead_triceps_extension.apparatus: a cable station with the pulley set low and a rope attachment, the mannequin standing facing away from the tower in a staggered stance
overhead_triceps_extension.view: side view, mannequin facing right (away from the tower), cable running up behind the neck
overhead_triceps_extension.start: standing in a staggered stance, upper arms raised beside the ears pointing up, elbows bent so the rope is behind the head, triceps stretched
overhead_triceps_extension.end: arms extended fully overhead, elbows straight, upper arms still beside the ears, triceps contracted
overhead_triceps_extension.path: the hands travel in an arc from behind the head up to overhead, elbows fixed
